body.description: Introduces the greeting through a concrete neighbor scene.

instruction.value: Look at the scene and choose the greeting.
Посмотри на сцену и выбери приветствие.

needsWorkMessage.value: Look at the people and try once more.
Посмотри на людей и попробуй ещё раз.

body.description: Checks recognition of the greeting and introduction phrases by ear.

instruction.value: Listen and choose what you hear.

needsWorkMessage.value: Focus on the first words and listen again.
Сосредоточься на первых словах и послушай снова.

recoveryMessage.value: Use replay or the written fallback.

body.description: Builds the name and origin phrases from ordered word blocks.

instruction.value: Build the introduction from the word blocks.

needsWorkMessage.value: Start with the speaker and then add the detail.
Начни с говорящего, затем добавь подробность.

recoveryMessage.value: Use tap controls instead of dragging.

body.description: Supports a scripted spoken attempt after listening to the model.

needsWorkMessage.value: Try once more with the model.
Попробуй ещё раз вместе с образцом.

body.description: Elicits a short spontaneous name or origin response with a typed fallback.

instruction.value: Answer the question in your own words.

needsWorkMessage.value: Use the meaning cue and answer once more.
Используй смысловую подсказку и ответь снова.

body.description: Runs the prepared introduction as a deterministic turn-taking dialogue.

needsWorkMessage.value: Follow the turn cue and try the reply again.
Следуй подсказке очереди и повтори ответ.

recoveryMessage.value: Continue through the typed dialogue route.

body.description: Declares which measured learning constructs may become evidence.
Maps deterministic activity observations to bounded result classifications.
Defines completion-compatible progress without claiming mastery.
Maps bounded activity performance to non-mastery reward output.
Selects bounded retry and deterministic accessibility fallback behavior.

canDoOutcome.value: Greet someone, say my name, country and language, and close the introduction.

communicativeGoal.value: Introduce yourself and invite a reply

successCondition.value: Exchange names and origins and close politely

learnerMeaning.value: Invite the other person to answer
